slot 28 light matrix setup, 23.8% (499/486). Retail keeps extent=max(x,z) in memory ([esp+0xc], redundant reload), reloads [ecx+0x54] for the 2nd texture->size read and uses frame 0x48; none of the source shapes tried reproduce these

slot 27 footprint (353/3031 B, frame 0xdc vs 0xd0). Both light modes decoded: mode 1 casts the four frustum corner rays once, mode 2 walks each near->far ray in look*3 steps; the hit cells' +0x24/+0x26 grid coordinates and the projected hits' screen x/y are min/maxed, then the 10x5 pixel viewport test. The accumulate/finish text is repeated per mode (macros): as inline helpers VC6 exhausts the expansion budget before the first corner. Left: slot order, the cross product's operand order (retail re-reads shadow->camera for every use) and the corner loops' form
